title: Code and data for: Mechanical versus biological valve prostheses in Brazil's public health system, 2000–2025: a nationwide analysis of 305 566 admissions
description: Analysis code, SHA-256 hashes of the public DATASUS input files and aggregated results (tables, figures and supplementary tables) for a nationwide study of surgical valve-prosthesis choice in Brazil's public health system (SIH/SUS), 2000–2025. No microdata are distributed; hospitals appear only under pseudonymous codes.
